sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the standard of review for federal sentencing decisions. the side that brought the case seeks uniform application of sentencing rules. The government argues for deference to trial court expertise.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The standard of review shapes how consistently federal courts apply sentencing guidelines. It determines whether trial judges hold final authority over sentencing facts. This affects the predictability of criminal penalties nationwide.
